say:1:1033524001:1.text: I'm fine, thanks to you...  You're a hero for getting rid of those gruglins. We're all safe because of you.
say:1:1033524001:1.source_cn: 没事，没事……多亏了你才没事啊，大英雄，是你赶走了那群...
say:1:1033524001:1.male: I'm fine, thanks to you...  You're a hero for getting rid of those gruglins. We're all safe because of you.
say:1:1033524001:1.female: I'm fine, thanks to you...  You're a hero for getting rid of those gruglins. We're all safe because of you.

say:2:1033524002:1.text: Those little beasts can make all the mess they want, but it's just heartbreaking to see all the food go to waste.
say:2:1033524002:1.source_cn: 那群小畜生怎么闹都行，就是糟蹋食物让人看着难受啊。

say:3:1033524003:1.text: *Sigh*... Give me a minute to gather myself. I'll go in and see what's left, then I'll bring everything back for everyone to share.
say:3:1033524003:1.source_cn: 唉……容我喘口气，再进去看看还剩下多少，给大伙带回去分了吧。
